original_failure: ValueError or EOFError at read time; node generation itself raises AssertionError: failed to dump nodes as json (native message: 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.')

root_cause.summary: TypeTreeGeneratorAPI crashes while resolving the field `_subcategoriesData` declared as a raw generic instantiation `SerializableDictionaryBase<CarCategoryType, CarSubcategoryDataList>` (from RotaryHeart.Lib.SerializableDictionary, a third-party asset) directly on this class - not through a named, non-generic subclass. Confirmed present in the decompiled source: out/cpp2il/DiffableCs/Assembly-CSharp/PWC/AvatarMaker/AvatarMakerCarSubcategoriesConfig.cs.
root_cause.mechanism: SerializableDictionaryBase<TKey,TValue> declares [SerializeField] private TKey[] _keys; TValue[] _values; (plus a legacy _keyValues list). When TKey/TValue are supplied as a raw, unnamed closed generic instantiation on the field itself (rather than via a concrete non-generic subclass), TypeTreeGeneratorAPI's native IL2CPP metadata walker throws an internal null reference exception while trying to resolve the specialized array element types - before any type tree node is produced for this class at all.
root_cause.confirmed_not_a_parsing_bug_in_this_repo: This is identical in nature to the bug already fixed in tools/mb_dump.py (fix_mislabeled_vectors, for mislabeled List<String> root nodes) but happens one level earlier and inside the native extension itself - there is no Python-side node list to post-process, because get_nodes_as_json() raises before returning anything. TypeTreeGeneratorAPI is already at its latest published version (0.0.10, checked 2026-11-21); no newer release to try.

fix: None available without a different type-tree extraction tool (this one cannot resolve raw generic SerializableDictionaryBase<K,V> fields at all).
resolvability: Blocked on tooling, not on data or analysis effort.
